Engineering Manager – Payments Platform
Larkspur Financial · Toronto (hybrid) or remote in Canada

About the role
Lead a team of 7 backend engineers who build and run the systems that move $2B a year.

What you'll do
- Coach and grow engineers through regular 1:1s and career plans
- Partner with product on roadmap and delivery
- Own hiring for your team
- Keep our services reliable and our on-call humane

What we need
- 2+ years of people management experience leading software engineers
- 5+ years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into management
- Experience hiring and building teams
- Comfortable running agile teams (Scrum or Kanban)
- Background in distributed systems
- Familiarity with Java, Kotlin or AWS is a plus

Perks
- Salary $190k–$220k CAD plus equity
- 18 weeks parental leave top-up, $2,000 learning budget, wellness account

Larkspur is committed to employment equity and welcomes applications from women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities.
